Subject: Re: Private deployment options — pricing follow-up

Sofia,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. The execs want to move forward but have two asks before we loop Legal:

1) Can you smooth the upfront platform fee across the first 12 months (we prefer predictable monthly amortization rather than a lump sum)?
2) We need clarity on the ops/support bands — specifically what counts as "Platform bug" vs "Integration engineering" for the on-prem support hours.

Attached is the SOW draft (Helix_IaaS_SOW_v3.pdf) — it reflects our expected phasing. We also flagged that some of the early deployment tasks (network validation, storage tuning) look like they could push us into a higher retainer band unless discounted.

High level ask: if you can provide a smoothing proposal + a one-time implementation credit (to cover initial integration engineering), we can sign the SOW and start procurement approvals.

Appreciate a quick sketch of numbers (monthly amortized platform fee, support-band definition, and a one-time credit) so I can brief Finance tomorrow.

Best,
Oliver
Head of Platform Engineering
HelixHealth

Marissa/Ben — forwarding Helix's asks. Key points:

- They want the platform fee amortized monthly (12 months) instead of a lump-sum invoice.
- They want clearer boundaries for support bands and a one-time implementation credit to offset heavy integration work.

Quick thoughts from pricing: we can amortize the platform fee on 12-month term if we move them from the Pilot SLAs to a Starter Commitment (minimum commit covers base cost). That reduces our cash deferral risk but requires a slightly higher monthly unit price. I think we can offer a $60k implementation credit (one-time) if they commit to a 12-month starter and a 20% increase to the monthly platform rate over base.

Questions for you both:
- Ben: is $60k a reasonable implementation credit from a margin perspective (we'd offset via reduced onboarding labor charge)?
- Marissa: can you sketch the support-band language (what is billable integration vs included ops)? We should include a 24/7 oncall surcharge option and a defined Run vs Build split.

I'll hold off responding to Oliver until we align.

Sofia
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Sofia/Marissa — quick cost view:

- $60k implementation credit is acceptable if we classify the bulk of early work as a one-time professional-services scope that we then invoice against the credit. That keeps the onboard PM/SE time as billable but offset. Net margin still ~25% post-credit if we cap the credit to 160 SE hours.
- Amortize platform fee over 12 months: we can present two price lines — amortized (monthly) + an equivalent upfront option for their Finance team. Practically we still want a minimum first invoice equal to one month of amortized platform fee + first-month usage to cover ramp costs.
- Support bands: propose three buckets — Run (included up to X hours/week), Minor Integration (time-and-materials with discounted rate), Major Integration/Feature (SOW). Add optional Oncall (24/7) at an uplift.

I'll draft a short markup for Marissa to convert into contract language. If Helix still asks for a deeper discount, run it through me first — we should prioritize preserving the starter commitment.

Ben
Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Trent <oliver.trent@helixhealth.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment fee smoothing & ops-band request — HelixHealth

Oliver — thanks for the clear asks. Based on internal review, here is a proposal you can present to Finance: 

1) Platform fee smoothing: we will amortize the 12-month platform fee across the first 12 monthly invoices. Option presented as two lines on the quote: a) Amortized monthly platform fee = €24,500/month; b) Equivalent upfront option = €270,000 (one-time). Either works — Finance typically prefers the amortized line. First invoice will include the first amortized month + first-month usage (to cover ramp).

2) Implementation credit: one-time credit of €55,000 applied against initial PS invoices (capped at 150 SE hours). We picked €55k to balance onboarding coverage and margin. Any additional integration beyond the cap converts to T&M at our standard PS rate (discounted 10% for this deal).

3) Support bands (contract language sketch):
- Run (Included): platform health, standard patching, incident response (SLA-defined), up to 8 hours/week of platform ops included.
- Minor Integration (Discounted T&M): configuration changes, connectors, and network validation work. Billable at discounted PS rate; credit applied first.
- Major Integration (SOW): API surface changes, custom features, or multi-site orchestration — scoped via SOW and invoiced separately.
- Optional Oncall: 24/7 oncall available at +20% uplift to the monthly platform amortized fee.

4) Next steps: if Helix accepts, we'll:
- Update the SOW with the credit and support-band language (I can have a redline by EOD Monday).
- Provide an amortized quote export (spreadsheet) for Finance to show monthly cashflow.
- Prep a DocuSign SOW with the two invoice options visible.

If that framing works, I'll send a formal commercial redline and the amortized quote. Happy to jump on a 20-min call with Finance if helpful.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
